titleEn: Dopamine and the trap that keeps you glued to your phone
summaryEn:
You open TikTok meaning to watch for just a few minutes, but when you look up, almost an hour has gone by. Meanwhile, studying, exercising or finishing an important task seems much harder to start.

This is not simply "laziness"; part of the answer lies in how the brain's reward system learns and prioritises behaviours that deliver quick rewards.
